name: mern-blog-app
description: Containerized MERN Stack Blog Application with Docker, Docker Compose, CI/CD, and Render Deployment

scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/public', {recursive:true});"

author: Anushka Bera
